entities.name: Nagasaki National Peace Memorial Hall for the Atomic Bomb Victims
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Nagasaki National Peace Memorial Hall for the Atomic Bomb Victims  is a commemorative monument in Nagasaki, Japan, situated next to its Atomic Bomb Museum. The Peace Park is nearby.
